findings.title: Demo click arm bypasses notification_target_path - vacancy-typed demo clicks still no-op; routing decision duplicated inline (still present since round 1; advisory test gate: FAIL)
findings.evidence: let navigate_eff = case entity_type, entity_id { | Some("application"), Some(aid) -> case demo_store.find_vacancy_id_for_application(store, aid) { ... | _, _ -> effect.none() }
findings.detail: Round-2 lens-guard requires BOTH real and demo click arms to route through notification_target_path/3. The demo arm re-implements the application branch inline and has no vacancy branch, so vacancy-typed demo notifications never navigate and the two routing contracts can drift. The helper already prefers the demo store, so the demo arm could call it directly (it lives in client.gleam, which demo_update cannot import - move it to a neutral module).
findings.recommended_fix: Move notification_target_path (and resolve_application_vacancy) into a neutral module importable by both arms; make the demo arm call it, gaining vacancy navigation; pin both arms with tests.

findings.title: Late ApiReturnedLeaderboard response re-fabricates a wrong vacancy id - leaderboard_vacancy_id is stamped at request time, never verified from the response (B1 residual, still present since round 1 class)
findings.evidence: ApiReturnedLeaderboard(Result(leaderboard.LeaderboardResponse, ApiError)) ... leaderboard: Success(response.entries), (no leaderboard_vacancy_id set, no vacancy-id guard)
findings.detail: The response message carries no vacancy id. Sequence: VacancyDetail(A) fetch in flight (tag A) -> navigate to VacancyDetail(B) (tag flips to B) -> A's response lands -> Success(A entries) tagged B. The resolver guard then passes for route B and list.find hits an A application, resolving the fabricated B. The refresh handler (ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh) already guards with vacancy_detail_request_id; the plain handler does not.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the vacancy id to ApiReturnedLeaderboard (and the page variant) and apply the response only when it matches the in-flight request (or re-stamp the tag from the response id).
